newsitem.title: UK: Nat. Grid to spend 50 mln stg on London.
newsitem.headline: Nat. Grid to spend 50 mln stg on London.

text.p: Britain's National Grid Group Plc said on Monday it plans to spend 50 million pounds to improve the reliability of the high-voltage electricity supply system in London.
It said in a statement the investment decision came at a time when demand for electricity in London was growing rapidly.

National Grid, which owns and operates the high voltage transmission system throughout England and Wales, noted that electricity use in London increased by over four percent in the first six months of this financial year.

"More and more power is flowing across our system serving London and customers have made it very clear that they place a high value on security," said National Grid's transmission managing director Roger Urwin.
The company plans to carry out the work in the next three years. ($1=.6120 Pound)
